name: Vampire's Invitation
source:
A handsome guy wakes you up in the middle of an empty lecture hall and starts a very... unusual conversation.

[From [url=https://dillayaart.itch.io/vampires-invitation]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你睡醒时发现自己身在一间空荡荡的大教室里，是个帅哥叫醒了你。他跟你聊了起来，聊的内容相当…不同寻常。
